# Manage

The **Vendors** module enables authorized administrators to manage and monitor vendor or merchant-partner records within the CorpCash platform. It provides a centralized view of vendor information, including vendor identification, wallet balance, transaction activity, pending settlements, account status, and the date of the last update.

Administrators can use this module to **view vendor records, search for specific vendors, filter vendors by status, export vendor data, and add new vendors**.

## Vendor List

The **All Vendors** section displays the vendors associated with the organization.

Each vendor is represented as an individual row containing key operational and financial information.

<figure><img src="../../../../.gitbook/assets/image (12).png" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

<table><thead><tr><th width="143">Field</th><th>Description</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><strong>Vendor ID</strong></td><td>Displays the unique identifier assigned to the vendor. For example, <code>VND-001</code>.</td></tr><tr><td><strong>Vendor Name</strong></td><td>Displays the registered name of the vendor.</td></tr><tr><td><strong>Contact/Representative Name</strong></td><td>Displays the name associated with the vendor account or primary contact, where available.</td></tr><tr><td><strong>Wallet Balance</strong></td><td>Displays the current wallet balance associated with the vendor.</td></tr><tr><td><strong>Total Transactions</strong></td><td>Displays the total number of transactions recorded for the vendor.</td></tr><tr><td><strong>Pending Settlement</strong></td><td>Displays the amount currently pending settlement for the vendor.</td></tr><tr><td><strong>Status</strong></td><td>Displays the current status of the vendor account.</td></tr><tr><td><strong>Last Updated</strong></td><td>Displays the date on which the vendor record was last updated.</td></tr><tr><td><strong>Actions</strong></td><td>Provides actions available for the selected vendor, such as <strong>View</strong>.</td></tr></tbody></table>

## Search Vendors

The **Search Vendors** functionality enables administrators to quickly locate a specific vendor or identify a set of vendor records from the Vendors listing. It is particularly useful when the vendor list contains a large number of records and manually locating a vendor would be time-consuming.

The search field is available at the top-right section of the **Vendors** management page and is displayed with the placeholder **“Search vendors...”**.

<figure><img src="../../../../.gitbook/assets/image (13).png" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

Administrators can enter relevant vendor information into the search field, and the system displays the vendor records matching the entered search criteria.
